meta.description: Score Lab v0.3 golden outputs and the SAMPLE inputs that produced them. Every number is invented sample data: test fixture only, never production. Acceptance check for CSN-031 to CSN-038: feed inputs through the engine and match outputs within tolerance.points (labels exactly).

series.note: p = daily closes for all days (oldest first); v = daily volume for the last volumeDays days only (index 0 = day days - volumeDays). Full prices are needed by the 200-week MA (1400 days), the archetype base rates and the Bitcoin outlook base rates; no volume read in the Lab reaches further back than 366 days from the scored day.
